title: 论文20：物理信息 DeepONet 与无输出标签的算子训练
titleEn: Paper20: Physics-informed DeepONet and operator training without output labels
summary: 从监督算子学习衔接跨函数的物理残差，比较数据、物理与混合训练，检查导数、泛化与信息限制。
summaryEn: Connect supervised operators with cross-function physics residuals; compare data, physics and hybrid training with checked derivatives and independent generalisation tests.

sources.name: Wang, Wang & Perdikaris (2021), Learning the solution operator of parametric partial differential equations with physics-informed DeepONets
sources.text: Primary physics-informed operator learning using differential-equation residuals across input functions. Our finite Poisson family and analytic smooth-trunk derivatives are CPU teaching adaptations, not original large benchmarks.

sources.name: Nine paired CPU controls and independent derivative checks
sources.text: Same 465-parameter architecture and initial states per seed. Data-only, physics-only and hybrid; all final checkpoints, held-out fields, residuals and extrapolation results retained.

beats.text: 先连接热源函数、物理信息以及共享分支主干架构。再推导每个输入的残差，解释配对训练对照。最后检查真实训练回放、独立场、残差与外推，总结二十篇路线。
beats.textEn: First connect source functions, physical information and a shared branch–trunk architecture. Then derive the per-input residual and explain the matched training controls. Finally inspect saved training, independent fields, residuals and extrapolation before concluding the twenty-paper route.

slides.title: 上一讲学会了映射，但映射遵守方程吗？
slides.titleEn: We learned a map. Does that map obey the equation?
bullets: 上一讲学会了映射，但映射遵守方程吗？
bulletsEn: We learned a map. Does that map obey the equation?

nodes.label: 上篇：成对标签训练解算子
nodes.labelEn: Previously: paired labels train a solution operator

nodes.label: 本篇：让每个输入的输出满足物理
nodes.labelEn: Now: constrain the output physics for each input

beats.text: 上一讲从热源与解的成对样例学习温度。标签位置拟合得好，并不保证其他位置的曲率正确。
beats.textEn: The last lesson learned temperatures from paired source and solution examples. A good fit at labelled positions did not guarantee the correct curvature elsewhere.

beats.text: 能否改用方程训练同一个算子？带着这个问题，比较标签、物理以及二者结合。
beats.textEn: Can we train the same operator using the equation instead? Keep that question in mind as we compare labels, physics and their combination.

slides.title: 仍然改变热源，预测整条稳态温度场
slides.titleEn: Vary the source and predict a complete steady temperature field
bullets: 仍然改变热源，预测整条稳态温度场
bulletsEn: Vary the source and predict a complete steady temperature field

beats.text: 上方是带符号热源 f。下方是稳态温度 u。正热源表示相对参考的加热，x 是单位杆上的位置。
beats.textEn: The upper curve is the signed source f; the lower curve is its steady temperature u. Positive source means heating relative to the reference. X is position on a unit rod.

beats.text: 改变热源，就改变了需要求解的温度。这段动画扫描热源参数，不是瞬态加热；两条纵轴分别缩放。
beats.textEn: Changing the source changes the solution we want. This animation sweeps source parameters; it is not transient heating. The two vertical axes have independent scales.

slides.title: 同一个规律，约束整个输入函数族
slides.titleEn: One physical law constrains an entire family of inputs
bullets: 同一个规律，约束整个输入函数族
bulletsEn: One physical law constrains an entire family of inputs

beats.text: 下标 x x 表示空间二阶导数。导热率缩放为一，两端温度都为零。
beats.textEn: The subscript x x means the second spatial derivative. Conductivity has been scaled to one, and both endpoint temperatures are zero.

beats.text: 对每个热源函数 f，算子都应输出满足同一规律的不同温度场。一个共享参数集合学习许多相关解。
beats.textEn: For each source function f, the operator must produce a different field satisfying this same rule. We are learning many related solutions with one shared set of weights.

slides.title: 没有输出标签，不等于没有已知信息
slides.titleEn: No output labels does not mean no known information
bullets: 没有输出标签，不等于没有已知信息
bulletsEn: No output labels does not mean no known information

nodes.label: 已知：热源函数、方程和端点条件
nodes.labelEn: Known: source functions, equation and endpoints

nodes.label: 待学习：热源到温度的映射
nodes.labelEn: Learn: the map from sources to temperatures

beats.text: 纯物理训练仍知道每个残差位置的热源，也知道微分方程与边界条件。
beats.textEn: Physics-only training still knows the source at every residual location. It also knows the differential equation and the boundary conditions.

beats.text: 它不接收训练查询位置的精确温度。精确解单独用于评估，以及明确标注的数据对照。
beats.textEn: What it does not receive is the exact temperature at training queries. We keep exact solutions separately for evaluation and for the explicitly labelled controls.

slides.title: 固定小型热源族，保持与上一讲的联系
slides.titleEn: Keep a small source family linked to the previous lesson
bullets: 固定小型热源族，保持与上一讲的联系
bulletsEn: Keep a small source family linked to the previous lesson

nodes.label: 24 个训练热源，9 个固定输入传感器
nodes.labelEn: 24 training sources, 9 fixed input sensors

nodes.label: 16 个新热源用于独立测试
nodes.labelEn: 16 new sources for independent testing

beats.text: m 编号三个正弦模式，a m 是各模式系数。训练系数位于负一到一之间。
beats.textEn: M indexes three sine modes, and a m is the coefficient of each mode. Training coefficients lie between minus one and one.

beats.text: 分支看到九个中点热源读数，而不是这些系数。独立保留十六个不同函数，不使用它们的温度更新网络。
beats.textEn: The branch sees nine midpoint source readings, not those coefficients. We hold out sixteen different functions and never use their temperatures to update the network.

slides.title: 保持同一个分支与主干，只改变训练信息
slides.titleEn: Keep the branch and trunk fixed; change the training information
bullets: 保持同一个分支与主干，只改变训练信息
bulletsEn: Keep the branch and trunk fixed; change the training information

nodes.label: B：编码九个热源读数
nodes.labelEn: B: encode nine source readings

nodes.label: T：编码查询位置 x
nodes.labelEn: T: encode query position x

beats.text: 粗体 f 是九个读数组成的传感向量。B 是分支，T 是主干，k 编号八个学习特征，b 零是共享输出偏置。
beats.textEn: Bold f is the nine-value sensor vector. B is the branch, T is the trunk, k indexes eight learned features, and b zero is a shared output bias.

beats.text: 三个对照都使用相同的非线性分支与主干，共四百六十五参数。每个起点编号下，它们从完全相同的权重开始。
beats.textEn: Every control uses this same nonlinear branch and trunk with four hundred and sixty-five parameters. Within each starting identifier, all three begin from identical weights.

slides.title: 先用结构保证两端，再学习内部物理
slides.titleEn: Guarantee the endpoints by construction, then learn the interior physics
bullets: 先用结构保证两端，再学习内部物理
bulletsEn: Guarantee the endpoints by construction, then learn the interior physics

nodes.label: 端点：p 为零，不需要边界惩罚
nodes.labelEn: Endpoints: p vanishes without a boundary penalty

nodes.label: 内部：仍需正确的温度与曲率
nodes.labelEn: Interior: temperature and curvature still need checking

beats.text: p 是固定边界因子。乘上 x 与一减 x，让每个输入函数对应的两个端点严格为零。
beats.textEn: P is a fixed boundary factor. Multiplying by x times one minus x makes both endpoints exactly zero for every input function.

beats.text: 这使比较无需边界惩罚，但不会保证内部正确。它是教学构造，不是论文对架构的要求。
beats.textEn: This removes a boundary penalty from our comparison. It does not make the interior correct, and it is our teaching construction rather than a requirement of the paper.

slides.title: 每个热源，都有自己的方程失配
slides.titleEn: Each source has its own equation mismatch
bullets: 每个热源，都有自己的方程失配
bulletsEn: Each source has its own equation mismatch

nodes.label: 对固定热源求空间二阶导数
nodes.labelEn: Differentiate in space with the source fixed

nodes.label: 与这个热源在当前位置的值比较
nodes.labelEn: Compare with this source at the same position

beats.text: r 是残差：预测温度曲率取负，再减已知热源。零值意味着这个函数、这个位置满足微分方程。
beats.textEn: R is the residual: minus the predicted temperature curvature, minus the known source. A zero value means the differential equation holds at this one function and position.

beats.text: 空间求导时保持热源向量固定。求导对象是查询坐标，不是传感器读数列表。
beats.textEn: The spatial derivative keeps the source vector fixed. We differentiate the query coordinate, not the list of sensor readings.

slides.title: 把跨函数的残差平方汇总
slides.titleEn: Pool squared residuals across functions and positions
bullets: 把跨函数的残差平方汇总
bulletsEn: Pool squared residuals across functions and positions

nodes.label: I = 24 个训练函数
nodes.labelEn: I = 24 training functions

nodes.label: J = 16 个内部中点
nodes.labelEn: J = 16 interior midpoints

beats.text: I 是训练函数数，J 是每个函数的残差位置数。这里二十四乘十六，得到三百八十四个物理约束。
beats.textEn: I counts training functions and J counts residual positions for each function. Here twenty-four times sixteen gives three hundred and eighty-four physics constraints.

beats.text: 它们是采样约束，不是精确积分，也不是对所有热源的证明。共享权重必须同时降低这些失配。
beats.textEn: These are sampled constraints, not an exact integral or a proof over every source. The same shared weights must reduce all of them together.

slides.title: 边界因子也参与求导，不能漏掉交叉项
slides.titleEn: Differentiate the boundary factor too: retain the cross term
bullets: 边界因子也参与求导，不能漏掉交叉项
bulletsEn: Differentiate the boundary factor too: retain the cross term

nodes.label: p、p′、p″ 都贡献曲率
nodes.labelEn: p, p′ and p″ all contribute to curvature

nodes.label: 对完整输出求导，再构造残差
nodes.labelEn: Differentiate the complete output before forming the residual

beats.text: 这是两次乘积求导。v x 与 v x x 是未包装预测 v 对查询位置的一阶、二阶导数。
beats.textEn: This is the product rule applied twice. V x and v x x are the first and second query derivatives of the unwrapped prediction v.

beats.text: 中间项来自两个因子各求一次导数。漏掉它，即使损失很小，也是在训练错误的物理方程。
beats.textEn: The middle term comes from differentiating both factors once. Dropping it would train the wrong physical equation even if the loss became small.

slides.title: CPU 加速使用解析主干导数，并与自动微分交叉验证
slides.titleEn: Use checked analytic trunk derivatives to keep the CPU experiment small
bullets: CPU 加速使用解析主干导数，并与自动微分交叉验证
bulletsEn: Use checked analytic trunk derivatives to keep the CPU experiment small

nodes.label: 原文：自动微分构造物理残差
nodes.labelEn: Paper: automatic differentiation for physics residuals

nodes.label: 本实验：光滑 tanh 主干的等价解析导数
nodes.labelEn: Here: equivalent analytic derivatives of the smooth tanh trunk

beats.text: 原文使用自动微分。这个小型 tanh 主干的一阶、二阶导数有简单解析表达，可减少重复坐标计算图。
beats.textEn: The paper uses automatic differentiation. Our tiny tanh trunk has simple analytic first and second derivatives, which avoid repeating expensive coordinate graphs.

beats.text: 独立测试把输出、两阶导数以及参数梯度与完整自动微分比较。解析公式仍可对权重求导，并非脱离训练图的目标。
beats.textEn: We independently compare outputs, both derivatives and parameter gradients against full automatic differentiation. The formulas remain differentiable with respect to the weights; they are not detached training targets.

slides.title: 一个训练步骤：已知热源，预测温度，检查曲率
slides.titleEn: One training step: known source, predicted field, checked curvature
bullets: 一个训练步骤：已知热源，预测温度，检查曲率
bulletsEn: One training step: known source, predicted field, checked curvature

beats.text: 先对各热源计算分支，在查询位置计算主干导数，再结合边界因子得到完整二阶导数。
beats.textEn: First evaluate the branch for each source and the trunk derivatives at query positions. Combine them with the boundary factor to obtain the full second derivative.

beats.text: 减去已知热源，平方并平均。反向传播同时更新分支与主干。纯物理路径不请求任何精确训练温度。
beats.textEn: Subtract the known forcing, square and average. Backpropagation then updates both branch and trunk. No exact training temperature is requested in this physics-only path.

slides.title: 三种信息来源，同架构、同起点、同步数
slides.titleEn: Three information sources, with matched architecture, starts and updates
bullets: 三种信息来源，同架构、同起点、同步数
bulletsEn: Three information sources, with matched architecture, starts and updates

nodes.label: 数据：72 标签；物理：0 输出标签
nodes.labelEn: Data: 72 labels; physics: 0 output labels

nodes.label: 混合：72 标签 + 384 物理约束
nodes.labelEn: Hybrid: 72 labels + 384 physics constraints

beats.text: 数据对照对每个训练函数使用三个温度标签。纯物理对每个函数使用十六个残差位置，混合则同时使用二者。
beats.textEn: The data control uses three temperature labels per training function. Physics-only uses sixteen residual positions per function. Hybrid uses both.

beats.text: 全部使用两千四百步 Adam、零点零零三学习率以及单线程 CPU。信息数量与每步计算成本仍然不同。
beats.textEn: All use two thousand four hundred Adam updates, a learning rate of point zero zero three and one CPU thread. Information counts and per-step computational costs still differ.

slides.title: 明确损失尺度，混合权重不是自动公平的
slides.titleEn: Disclose loss scales: equal weights are not automatically balanced
bullets: 明确损失尺度，混合权重不是自动公平的
bulletsEn: Disclose loss scales: equal weights are not automatically balanced

nodes.label: u*：仅用于有标签的训练对照
nodes.labelEn: u*: available only to labelled training controls

nodes.label: 固定温度尺度，物理项权重为一
nodes.labelEn: Fixed temperature scale; residual weight one

beats.text: u 星表示精确温度标签，π 的平方决定固定温度尺度。L d 是缩放标签损失，L h 是混合损失。
beats.textEn: U star denotes an exact temperature label, and pi squared sets a fixed temperature scale. L d is the scaled label loss; L h is the hybrid loss.

beats.text: 混合项系数都为一，但梯度未必平衡。这里公开这个选择，不声称它是最优权重策略。
beats.textEn: Both hybrid terms have coefficient one, but their gradients need not be balanced. We disclose this choice rather than claiming an optimal weighting strategy.

slides.title: 观察新热源的预测如何改变
slides.titleEn: Watch predictions change for a source excluded from training
bullets: 观察新热源的预测如何改变
bulletsEn: Watch predictions change for a source excluded from training

beats.text: 虚线是一个未参与训练热源的精确温度。各颜色使用不同训练目标。现在观察保存的检查点。
beats.textEn: The dashed curve is the exact temperature for one held-out source. Each colour uses a different training objective. Now watch the saved checkpoints.

beats.text: 显示误差合并十六个独立测试函数。这一条曲线只是示意，不是全部验证集。保留所有最终检查点。
beats.textEn: The displayed error pools sixteen held-out functions. This one curve is an illustration, not the entire validation set. Every final checkpoint is kept.

slides.title: 加入物理，并没有在每个起点赢得场误差
slides.titleEn: Physics does not win the field-error comparison at every start
bullets: 加入物理，并没有在每个起点赢得场误差
bulletsEn: Physics does not win the field-error comparison at every start

beats.text: 这里显示三个起点的最终同族场误差。纯物理无需温度标签也能学习，但并不总是最准确。
beats.textEn: Here are the final in-family field errors for all three starting identifiers. Physics-only learns without temperature labels, but it is not uniformly the most accurate.

beats.text: 混合也没有在每个起点获胜。有限优化、稀疏约束和所选损失尺度仍然重要。保留这些结果，不挑选最佳种子。
beats.textEn: Hybrid also fails to win at every start. Finite optimisation, sparse constraints and the chosen loss scales still matter. We retain those outcomes rather than choosing the best seed.

slides.title: 换一条检查轴：未训练位置的物理残差
slides.titleEn: Check another axis: physics residuals at unseen positions
bullets: 换一条检查轴：未训练位置的物理残差
bulletsEn: Check another axis: physics residuals at unseen positions

beats.text: 这些残差在十六个独立测试函数、每个一百九十七个偏移位置评估。这些函数都没有训练模型。
beats.textEn: These residuals are evaluated at one hundred and ninety-seven shifted positions for the sixteen held-out functions. None of those functions trained the model.

beats.text: 本实验中物理与混合明显降低这个残差，但不强制场误差排名相同。方程一致性与解精度相关，却不能互相替代。
beats.textEn: Physics and hybrid reduce this residual substantially in our runs. That does not force the same field-error ranking. Equation consistency and solution accuracy are related checks, not interchangeable scores.

slides.title: 独立参考与未训练输入，都要保留
slides.titleEn: Retain independent references and completely unseen inputs
bullets: 独立参考与未训练输入，都要保留
bulletsEn: Retain independent references and completely unseen inputs

nodes.label: 201 个位置比较完整温度场
nodes.labelEn: Compare full temperature fields at 201 positions

nodes.label: 197 个偏移位置检查方程残差
nodes.labelEn: Check residuals at 197 shifted positions

beats.text: 精确正弦级数解来自对每个模式两次求导，用作评估参考。比较的是完整场，不只是三个标签位置。
beats.textEn: The exact sine-series solution is an evaluation reference, obtained by differentiating each mode twice. We evaluate complete fields, not only the three labelled positions.

beats.text: 另一个保护测试会在纯物理训练请求训练输出参考时立即报错。这验证实现声明，但不把验证本身说成无需参考。
beats.textEn: A guarded test also makes the physics-only training step fail if it requests training-output references. This verifies the implementation claim without pretending validation itself is label-free.

slides.title: 物理训练，也不会自动消除输入覆盖的限制
slides.titleEn: Physics training does not automatically remove input-coverage limits
bullets: 物理训练，也不会自动消除输入覆盖的限制
bulletsEn: Physics training does not automatically remove input-coverage limits

beats.text: 圆点使用更大振幅，方块使用未见第四热源模式。即使纯物理训练，第四模式也从未出现在训练残差中。
beats.textEn: Circles use larger amplitudes; squares use the unseen fourth source mode. The fourth mode did not occur in any training residual, even in physics-only training.

beats.text: 三个模型都可能在训练族外失败。知道物理方程有帮助，但有限学习算子并未精确求解每一种可能输入。
beats.textEn: All three models can fail outside the trained family. Knowing a physical equation is useful, but this finite learned operator has not solved it exactly for every possible input.

slides.title: 有限传感器的信息极限，仍然存在
slides.titleEn: Finite-sensor information limits still apply
bullets: 有限传感器的信息极限，仍然存在
bulletsEn: Finite-sensor information limits still apply

nodes.label: 相同传感向量，网络只能给出相同输出
nodes.labelEn: Same sensor vector implies the same deterministic output

nodes.label: 需要足够传感信息与输入覆盖
nodes.labelEn: Need sufficient sensor information and input coverage

beats.text: 回忆上一讲在九个传感器上都为零的热源。确定性分支仅靠这些读数无法把它与零热源区分。
beats.textEn: Recall the last lesson’s source that vanished at all nine sensors. A deterministic branch cannot distinguish that source from zero using those readings alone.

beats.text: 在有限训练族上增加残差，不会改变任意新输入的表示极限。可能需要更有信息的传感器，或明确限制输入类别。
beats.textEn: Adding residuals on the limited training family does not change that representation limit for arbitrary new inputs. More useful sensors or a restricted input class may be necessary.

slides.title: 保留论文机制，明确小实验的边界
slides.titleEn: Retain the paper mechanism and state the limits of this small experiment
bullets: 保留论文机制，明确小实验的边界
bulletsEn: Retain the paper mechanism and state the limits of this small experiment

nodes.label: 保留：跨输入函数的物理残差训练
nodes.labelEn: Retained: physics residual training across input functions

nodes.label: 改变：三模态 Poisson 族与解析导数实现
nodes.labelEn: Adapted: three-mode Poisson family and analytic derivatives

beats.text: 保留的是多个输入函数通过微分方程残差训练共享算子权重。纯物理路径无需成对训练温度。
beats.textEn: We retained shared operator weights trained through differential-equation residuals for many input functions. The physics-only path needs no paired training temperatures.

beats.text: 没有复现原文的大型函数集合或非线性基准。这个受控 CPU 例子解释机制与失败模式，不建立普适性能结论。
beats.textEn: We did not reproduce the paper’s large function ensembles or nonlinear benchmarks. This controlled CPU example explains the mechanism and its failure modes, rather than establishing universal performance.

slides.title: 没有温度标签的训练，究竟知道什么？
slides.titleEn: What does training without temperature labels still know?
bullets: 没有温度标签的训练，究竟知道什么？
bulletsEn: What does training without temperature labels still know?

nodes.label: 先列出：已知函数、方程与边界
nodes.labelEn: First list known functions, equations and boundaries

nodes.label: 再判断：新函数与点间误差如何验证？
nodes.labelEn: Then ask how to validate new inputs and gaps

beats.text: 在这里停一下。如果纯物理模型训练时从未看到精确温度，是不是没有信息也能学习？
beats.textEn: Pause here. If a physics-only model never sees exact temperatures during training, is it learning without information?

beats.text: 它仍看到已知热源函数、方程与端点条件。评估学习映射，要把新输入和独立位置与单独参考比较。小的采样残差本身不是证书。
beats.textEn: It still sees known source functions, the equation and endpoint conditions. To judge the learned map, test new inputs and independent positions against a separate reference. A small sampled residual alone is not a certificate.

slides.title: 二十篇路线：从解一个问题，到学习一族问题
slides.titleEn: Twenty-paper route: from solving one problem to learning a family
bullets: 二十篇路线：从解一个问题，到学习一族问题
bulletsEn: Twenty-paper route: from solving one problem to learning a family

nodes.label: 基础：求解、识别、训练与独立验证
nodes.labelEn: Core: solving, inference, training and independent checks

nodes.label: 进阶：分区、自适应与算子学习
nodes.labelEn: Extensions: decomposition, adaptation and operator learning

beats.text: 从一个方程的神经场出发，路线经过反问题、训练困难与独立物理检查。扩展部分加入分区、注意力以及函数到函数学习。
beats.textEn: We began with a neural field for one equation, then examined inverse problems, training difficulties and independent physical checks. The extensions added decomposition, attention and function-to-function learning.

beats.text: 共同习惯没有改变：解释物理图像，明确已有信息，比较合理对照，检查未见情况。这些习惯比新增架构名称更重要。
beats.textEn: The common habit is unchanged: explain the physical picture, state the available information, compare fair controls and check unseen cases. Those habits matter more than a new architecture name.
